package: M1 draft 0.20 (C29 strict SinkChecker grammar; full 0.19 V2 suite replayed under it)
evidenceKind: reference model of the specification text; deferred experiments are specifications only

results.text: maxRequests exhausted before a new attempt H(latest): no attempt id is open, so the model returns Error{tooManyRequests} without abort/begin (browser.md:107 names abort(id, ...)). Proposed supplement; case X-maxBeforeBegin.

Client-side consistency of -32020 fields (fromBlock = a, nextFromBlock = lc+1) treated as serverViolation; not written in step text (FINAL_DESIGN.md:2050-2052 states the server shape). Proposed supplement.
Malformed -32021 (no integer retryAfterMs / unknown reason) and -32022 with an unknown reason -> serverViolation. Proposed supplement.
Timeouts are inclusive and checked at each send: a request due at elapsed = timeout is sent; elapsed > timeout -> abort(timeout). Proposed convention.
maxBytes measured as UTF-8 bytes of the compact key-sorted JSON array per piece, cumulative per attempt; real wire bytes may differ. Proposed convention.
A malformed head reply before begin -> Error{headViolation} with no sink call. Proposed convention.
Branch block hashes, address and data tags are author-chosen literals; the source fixes structure, not values. Proposal.
The model waits exactly retryAfterMs / 500 ms; the source requires >= . Exact timing is a fixture choice.
Model only: no TypeScript LogClient, no Chrome, no pocold/RPC server (RG3, RG3b, RG9 not executed), no Node fetchEach tool, no BridgeAuth schema/tag resolution.

implementation.md:359 asks for literal JSON replies; the 0.19 fixtures express some replies as templates ('gen' log generator, 'repeat' data). A TypeScript harness needs either the same expansion rule or exported literal replies. Proposed supplement P-V2-10: publish the expanded replies as data.
The sink event grammar (types and arities) is implicit in browser.md:117-130. Proposed supplement P-V2-9 = the closed grammar of tools/sink_checker_strict.py.
